m01.question: How much did we sell in 2018?
m01.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS revenue_2018_brl FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2018-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2019-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 200

m02.question: How much revenue did customers in São Paulo state bring in during 2018?
m02.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS revenue_br FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2018-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2019-01-01' AS DATE) AND c.customer_state = 'SP' LIMIT 200

m03.question: How many orders were placed in 2017?
m03.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_2017 FROM orders AS o WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < (CAST('2017-12-31' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 DAY') LIMIT 200

m04.question: How many orders came from Rio de Janeiro state between March and June 2018?
m04.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_state = 'RJ' AND NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2018-03-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2018-07-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 200

m05.question: On average, how much did customers spend per order in 2018?
m05.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(oi.price) AS DECIMAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS average_order_value_brl FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2018-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2019-01-01' AS DATE) AND c.customer_state IS NOT NULL LIMIT 200

m06.question: What is the average order value for customers in Minas Gerais?
m06.sql: WITH valid_orders AS (SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_unique_id, SUM(oi.price) AS order_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND c.customer_state = 'MG' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2016-09-04' AS DATE) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2018-10-18' /* end date inclusive */ AS DATE) GROUP BY o.order_id, c.customer_unique_id) SELECT AVG(order_revenue) AS average_order_value FROM valid_orders LIMIT 200

m07.question: Show me the sales trend month by month for 2017.
m07.sql: SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_count, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue_brl FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2018-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', o.order_purchase_timestamp) ORDER BY month LIMIT 200

m08.question: How did monthly revenue from watches and gifts develop in the first half of 2018?
m08.sql: SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue_brl FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2018-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2018-07-01' AS DATE) AND p.category IN ('watches', 'gifts') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 200

m09.question: Which 5 product categories brought in the most revenue?
m09.sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue_brl FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2016-09-04' AS DATE) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2018-10-18' /* inclusive end date */ AS DATE) GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue_brl DESC LIMIT 5

m10.question: What were the top 3 categories by sales value for customers in Rio Grande do Sul in 2018?
m10.sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue_br FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND c.customer_state = 'RS' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2018-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2019-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue_br DESC LIMIT 3

m11.question: Which 5 categories sold the most items?
m11.sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) AS units_sold FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2016-09-04' AS DATE) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2018-10-18' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 5

m12.question: List the 10 most popular categories by number of units sold in 2017.
m12.sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) AS units_sold FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2018-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 10

m13.question: Which five customer states bring in the most revenue?
m13.sql: SELECT c.customer_state, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue_brl FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2016-09-04' AS DATE) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2018-10-18' /* end date inclusive */ AS DATE) GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY revenue_brl DESC LIMIT 5

m14.question: What were the top 10 customer states by revenue in 2017?
m14.sql: SELECT c.customer_state, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue_brl FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2018-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY revenue_brl DESC LIMIT 10

m15.question: What percentage of our customers placed more than one order?
m15.sql: WITH valid_orders AS (SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_unique_id FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2016-09-04' AS DATE) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2018-10-18' /* inclusive end date */ AS DATE)), customer_counts AS (SELECT customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders_cnt FROM valid_orders GROUP BY customer_unique_id) SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN orders_cnt > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS repeat_customer_rate_percent FROM customer_counts LIMIT 200

m16.question: What percentage of 2018 customers came back for another order that same year?
m16.sql: WITH valid_orders AS (SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_unique_id, CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS order_date FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2018-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2019-01-01' AS DATE)), customer_order_counts AS (SELECT customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders_cnt FROM valid_orders GROUP BY customer_unique_id) SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN orders_cnt >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS repeat_customer_rate_percent FROM customer_order_counts LIMIT 200

m17.question: Of the orders placed in 2017 that were delivered, what percentage arrived late?
m17.sql: WITH delivered_orders AS (SELECT o.order_id, DATE(o.order_delivered_customer_date) AS delivered_date, DATE(o.order_estimated_delivery_date) AS estimated_date FROM orders AS o WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2018-01-01' AS DATE)) SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_date > estimated_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL), 2) END AS late_delivery_percentage FROM delivered_orders LIMIT 200

m18.question: How often were deliveries to customers in Bahia late, as a percentage?
m18.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS late_delivery_rate_percent FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND c.customer_state = 'BA' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2016-09-04' AS DATE) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2018-10-18' AS DATE) LIMIT 200

m19.question: What is our average customer review score?
m19.sql: SELECT CAST(AVG(r.review_score) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS average_review_score FROM order_reviews AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2016-09-04' AS DATE) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2018-10-18' AS DATE) LIMIT 200

m20.question: How do customers rate orders that include health and beauty products, on average?

f01.question: For delivered orders that contain at least one bed_bath_table item, how much was paid in total with each payment type?
f01.sql: SELECT op.payment_type, SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_paid FROM orders AS o JOIN order_payments AS op ON o.order_id = op.order_id WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id AND p.category = 'bed_bath_table') GROUP BY op.payment_type LIMIT 200

f02.question: What is the total payment value of delivered orders that have more than one item?
f02.sql: SELECT SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_payment_value FROM orders AS o JOIN (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS multi ON multi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN order_payments AS op ON op.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' LIMIT 200

f03.question: What is the average total payment per delivered order, for orders that include a health_beauty item?
f03.sql: WITH hb_orders AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = 'health_beauty' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL), payments_per_order AS (SELECT op.order_id, SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_payment FROM order_payments AS op JOIN hb_orders AS h ON h.order_id = op.order_id GROUP BY op.order_id) SELECT CAST(AVG(total_payment) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS avg_total_payment_per_delivered_order FROM payments_per_order LIMIT 200

f04.question: How many sellers are there in each state?

f05.question: Which payment type is used most often?

f06.question: For delivered orders placed in 2018, what is the average number of calendar days from purchase to delivery?

f08.question: Across all order items, whatever the order status, which 5 customer states have the highest average freight charge per item?

a04.question: How good is our customer experience?
a04.sql: WITH params AS (SELECT CAST('2016-09-04' AS DATE) AS start_date, CAST('2018-10-17' AS DATE) AS end_date), valid_orders AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date, o.order_estimated_delivery_date, c.customer_unique_id, c.customer_state FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN params AS p ON 1 = 1 WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= p.start_date AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < p.end_date + INTERVAL '1 DAY'), repeat_stats /* repeat‑customer rate */ AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cu.customer_unique_id) AS total_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN cu.customer_unique_id END) AS repeat_customers FROM (SELECT customer_unique_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM valid_orders GROUP BY customer_unique_id) AS cu), late_stats /* late‑delivery rate (only delivered orders) */ AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE)) AS late_orders FROM valid_orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL), review_stats /* average review score for orders in the period (all statuses) */ AS (SELECT CAST(AVG(r.review_score) AS DECIMAL(5, 2)) AS avg_review_score FROM order_reviews AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.order_id = o.order_id JOIN params AS p ON 1 = 1 WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= p.start_date AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < p.end_date + INTERVAL '1 DAY') SELECT CASE WHEN rs.total_customers = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100.0 * rs.repeat_customers / rs.total_customers, 2) END AS repeat_customer_rate_percent, CASE WHEN ls.delivered_orders = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100.0 * ls.late_orders / ls.delivered_orders, 2) END AS late_delivery_rate_percent, rv.avg_review_score FROM repeat_stats AS rs CROSS JOIN late_stats AS ls CROSS JOIN review_stats AS rv LIMIT 200
